about: Adventures in underground and experimental music. A partner to the Freak Zone Playlist.

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 16 Dec. Welcome to the Freak Zone, your bespoke guide to the world of weird and wonderful music. Come for Anna Meredith, Philip Glass and Groundhogs, stay for the Swedish guitar improv and experimental Andean sound collages. Plus, Stuart's featured album is Dub Housing, the second release from "the colossi of Rust Belt Avante Garage" Pere Ubu.
items.title: Pere Ubu - Dub Housing

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 9 Dec. Its the Freak Zone, 6 Music's one-stop shop for all your left-field and experimental music needs. What's on special offer this week? There's contemporary Norwegian prog, Italian experimentalism and American drone folk. plus Gong, Greg Foat and the mighty John Barry. Meanwhile Stuart's featured album is American jazz guitar giant Sonny Sharrock's 1991 masterpiece Ask The Ages.
items.title: Sonny Sharrock - Ask the Ages

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 2 Dec. Welcome to the Freak Zone, 6 Music's home for all the weird and wonderful music you didn't know you needed to hear. This week there's math rock and wonky pop, groovy sounds from Turkey and Nigeria, top tunes from Brian, Keith and Vashti, and Purcell played by a pair of top Norwegian jazzers. Plus, Stuart's featured album is Robbie Basho's masterpiece of American primitive guitar Visions of the Country.
items.title: Robbie Basho's Visions of the Country

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 25 Nov. Stuart gets spooky and supernatural for All Hallows Eve. Expect werewolves, demons, witches and a blasphemous seal. There's music from Keith Emerson, Sun Ra and France Gall plus live advice from an LA witch.
items.title: The Freak Zone Halloween Special

name: Stuart Maconie's Freak Zone
